clips.title: The story
paras: In the Deadmines, Foreman Thistlenettle once led a dwarven mining crew. He worked for both the Miners' League and the Explorers' League until a cave-in trapped his crew below Moonbrook. He died with them and rose again as a ghoul, still carrying his guild badge through the dark, collapsed tunnels.
